purpose: Assess exactly 16 original runway geometry, wind and other-strip flow features

architecture.base: locally sealed v11 184-feature CatBoost residual to own AOBT proxy
architecture.trainer: deep_timestamp_expert.fit_fold with unchanged split and CatBoost parameters
architecture.fit_labels: finite 2025 targets in [0,86400] with AOBT proxy in [0,7200]
architecture.score_labels: all finite targets, including negative and extreme values
architecture.early_stop: same complement-month RNG permutation, six percent or 20,000, 200 patience

reference.outside_valid_proxy: copy locally sealed, unsubmitted v9 without change
reference.prior_may_september_guard: verify its already sealed v9 terminal as provenance only; those labels do not select any v12 weight or feature

original_folds.fit_and_early_stop: complementary 2025 months only; held months absent from both
original_folds.selection_rule: minimum clipped Jan/Jul all-finite RMSE; ties favor smaller weight
original_folds.formula: clip(v9 + w * (new_raw_200 - v9), lower=0) only on valid AOBT proxy
original_folds.forward_rule: same fixed Jan/Jul weight without adjustment
original_folds.gate: nonzero weight; all-finite RMSE improves and paired UTC-day bootstrap 95 percent lower gain >0 in both folds

fresh_april_october.reference: sealed v11 fresh_audit_predictions.v11_blend with both components excluding 4/10
fresh_april_october.replacement: same 200-feature residual architecture refit excluding 4/10 from fit and early stop
fresh_april_october.formula: clip(v11_blend + original selected weight * (new_raw_200 - v11_blend), lower=0)
fresh_april_october.gate: exact ID/target/UTC-time coverage; each month RMSE improves and pooled paired UTC-day CI lower gain >0

separate_guard.comparator: fresh v11 raw residual model excluding 2/8 from fit and early stop
separate_guard.replacement: fresh v12 raw residual model with identical exclusions and frozen weight
separate_guard.status: prospective separate protocol required; neither refit nor score is implemented here

builder.source: pre-2025 pinned public-domain OurAirports endpoints and released movements/NOAA wind
builder.batch_caveat: Counts use complete released batches. January/July 2026 batch boundaries may lack prior-window history present in full-year 2025 training.
builder.availability: retrospective released-batch context, not complete live traffic

final_and_ranking: refuse until separate February/August component guard is frozen, run and passed; missing policy remains unchanged
interpretation: Repeated 2025 component comparison, not an untouched generalization estimate or guaranteed prize rank
